_note: Patterns that must never appear in a publishable tree. Copy this to config/forbidden.local.json and put your real internal names there; that file is git-ignored. The example stays publishable: it holds only placeholders plus generic secret patterns that must never be committed by anyone.

allow.why: meta-doc: it names the categories publishing must not contain, so it necessarily mentions them

patterns.name: secrets
patterns.why: private keys and API tokens must never be committed; this one is active in the example on purpose

patterns.name: internal-host-name
patterns.why: any internal tool name goes in forbidden.local.json, never in tracked docs

patterns.name: billing-mechanism
patterns.why: pricing mechanics are commercially sensitive; keep the real term in forbidden.local.json

patterns.name: credit-estimates
patterns.why: internal cost model; use relative tiers instead

patterns.name: internal-model-codenames
patterns.why: model ids you do not want committed; use roles instead
